parts.name: shell_left
parts.note: Print on its outer side face (wordmark inlay on the bed). Supports: handle tub and hood ceiling.

parts.name: shell_right
parts.note: Print on its outer side face. Power-switch cutout is a placeholder.

parts.name: inlay_side_left
parts.note: Flush wordmark inlay, printed together with shell_left (multi-colour).

parts.name: inlay_side_right
parts.note: Flush wordmark inlay, printed together with shell_right (multi-colour).

parts.name: bezel_screen
parts.note: Print face-up (flange on the bed) as ONE multi-part object: dark shield/shroud + warm-grey face. Glass rests behind the shroud with a gap; no clamping.

parts.name: bezel_drives
parts.note: Print face-up as one multi-part object (dark + warm-grey face + nameplate inlay).

parts.name: bezel_screen_face
parts.note: Warm-grey grooved face, printed fused with bezel_screen.

parts.name: bezel_drives_face
parts.note: Warm-grey grooved face + legend, printed fused with bezel_drives.

parts.name: rear_panel_left
parts.note: Outer face on the bed. Flat-head M3 into the ledge inserts.

parts.name: rear_io_plate
parts.note: Replaceable I/O plate: cutouts finalised once panel-mount parts are chosen.

parts.name: lid_left
parts.note: Print on its outer face (front of the closed machine): flush logo inlays on the bed, deck badge inlays on top.

parts.name: lid_splice_1
parts.note: Recessed under the keyboard; joins the lid halves (2x M3 into inserts each side).

parts.name: lid_splice_2
parts.note: Recessed under the keyboard; joins the lid halves (2x M3 into inserts each side).

parts.name: inlay_lid_face
parts.note: Wordmark + model + diamond (multi-colour: diamond uses 4 Phosphor blues).

parts.name: hinge_case_1
parts.note: Printed knuckle block under the case. 3 mm steel pin. Print leaf-up (knuckle on bed side) or use supports.

parts.name: hinge_lid_1
parts.note: Printed knuckle block on the lid rear face.

parts.name: hinge_case_2
parts.note: Printed knuckle block under the case. 3 mm steel pin. Print leaf-up (knuckle on bed side) or use supports.

parts.name: hinge_lid_2
parts.note: Printed knuckle block on the lid rear face.

parts.name: latch_base_left
parts.note: Screws (M3, short inserts in the side wall) sit outside the lever path.

parts.name: latch_lever_left
parts.note: Pivot: 3 mm steel pin or M3 shoulder screw.

parts.name: latch_base_right
parts.note: Screws (M3, short inserts in the side wall) sit outside the lever path.

parts.name: latch_lever_right
parts.note: Pivot: 3 mm steel pin or M3 shoulder screw.

parts.name: handle
parts.note: Grip slides over an 8 mm metal rod (structural); legs pivot on 4 mm steel pins. Proof-load before trusting.

parts.name: drive_cage
parts.note: Drive screw slots are generic until the MPF-920 side-hole positions are measured.

parts.name: display_bracket
parts.note: M2.5 into the display rear outer pattern (thread depth not yet known: use the screws supplied with the display).

parts.name: coupon_C1_insert_holes
parts.note: Holes 3.9 / 4.0 / 4.1 mm (left to right). Pick the best and set p3.insert.hole_d.

parts.name: coupon_C3_seam_L
parts.note: Seam block + counterbore (pair with C3_seam_R).

parts.name: coupon_C3_seam_R
parts.note: Seam block + insert.

parts.name: coupon_C4_lip_corner
parts.note: Top-right lip corner; check the closed-lid gap against coupon C4_lid.

parts.name: coupon_C5_inlay
parts.note: Side wall slice with wordmark pocket; print with its inlay to tune colour change.

parts.name: coupon_C6_shroud_corner
parts.note: Shroud corner + flange with bezel screw hole.

m_edition.label: M Edition match (off-white, warm grey, blue accents)

brand.note: Fictional brand. Model name is a placeholder; see docs/concept-P2.md for alternatives. Stripes = P1 green, P3 amber, P4/blue phosphor types.
brand.style_note: 'italic' (default) = italic speed-cut wordmark everywhere, RetroOS diamond on lid face / deck / nameplate only; 'os' = Phosphor Mono pixel wordmark + diamonds incl. sides; 'stripes' = italic wordmark + green/amber/blue bars
